name: Tsuki no Nai Yoru (Episode 1)
source:
Boy gets in a storm and finds shelter in a mountain cabin. He starts to remember grandma's stories about demons wandering in such weather. Suddenly door opens...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名少年在暴风雨中找到一间山中小屋避难。他开始回想祖母讲过的故事——在这样的天气里，会有恶魔四处游荡。突然，门打开了…
